predecessors.name: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)
predecessors.text: Greece as Cliopatria's last pre-war shape (1940), before the Axis occupation of 1941-44, which no Cliopatria row covers

successors.name: Greek junta
successors.text: the Greek state under the colonels, from the coup of 21 April 1967

ledger.x: 1945: the restored Kingdom of Greece governs from Athens.
ledger.cpn: Greece (First Hellenic Republic, Kingdom of Greece, Second Hellenic Republic)

ledger.x: March 1946: the civil war resumes in northern Greece.
1948: the Democratic Army holds most of the Peloponnese.
Summer 1948: the National Army's plan 'Peristera' clears the Peloponnese; the page gives no day.

wars.name: Greek Civil War
wars.outcome: Government victory: the Democratic Army's main divisions retreated to Albania in September 1949 after Operation Pyrsos; infobox end 30 August 1949, ceasefire announced 16 October 1949.

certainty.note: Greece's frontiers are treaty lines; the Dodecanese line is the 1947 treaty's; the contested northern mountains 1946-49 are soft, being fought land with no drawn boundary.
